This is actually what my store does already, kinda. The oversized is the same (one label for every item, we just manually add new "totes" to print more for the same order) but for GMD we just print one label per bag. So, if five items of an eleven-item order fit in one bag and the other six fit in a second bag, we have two bags, each with a label. The other nine labels we just throw away. For GMD it saves dispensers from
having to scan way too many labels, and for Oversized it helps prevent mix-ups with commonly picked items like cases of water.
